main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x next-day excess return on up days

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: deepest third minus shallowest third mean excess next-day return < 0

decided_by: The mean gain is positive with t >= 2 and the deepest third's mean excess next-day return minus the shallowest third's is below 0.
reading: Up-day cases are the bars whose regime is mean_reversion with a next-day close in the same window, the coin's mean daily return is over all its windows' next-day returns, the t clusters cases by UTC day (deviations summed per day, with a D/(D-1) correction), the thirds are n//3 cases each from sorting the forecast (lowest = deepest), the situation check leaves out each window's first bar, and the plan's 'too few cases' rule is reported as not observable as the workflow requires.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0008131 on the check folds against +0.002766 on every fold
